reason: We have plans in-house and our designer already covers renders, so I'm not paying a vendor per plan. And my buyers are spec buyers, so a custom-home walkthrough is a thing the homeowner would have to want, not me.
objection: I wouldn't pay for it; the homeowner would have to agree to it. At $450 a plan across a library of 60 plans that's real money for something our in-house person already does.
would_change_my_mind: A free pilot on one plan that visibly lifted contract conversions on a spec home, plus a per-plan price under about $150 so I could roll it across the library.
